decisions.decision: Multi-module Gradle setup with :engine (pure Kotlin + OpenGL ES 3.x render core, document model, action tree, effect engine) and :app (Jetpack Compose Material 3 Expressive UI).
Downloaded 44MB Keyflaw APK and uploaded to reference-keyflaw GitHub pre-release. Studied architecture without copying proprietary code.
Query GL_MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE at startup, clamp offscreen texture dimensions to maximum GPU supported texture size, and downsample preview proxy.
Branching DAG graph structure with O(1) state jumping across branches; clipboard decoupled from active tree node.

Added @Serializable to ProjectSummary to fix runtime SerializationException on indexFile.writeText(json.encodeToString(list)). Added comprehensive ProGuard rules preserving all com.motionssalt.saltygraphics.** and kotlinx.serialization classes. Wrapped enableEdgeToEdge() in runCatching and wrapped repository.loadProjects() in defensive try/catch. Removed windowLightStatusBar from themes.xml to prevent OEM inflation errors on Transsion/OEM Android variants.

known_issues.issue: Instant crash on launch before home screen appeared
known_issues.cause: ProjectSummary data class lacked @Serializable annotation, causing kotlinx.serialization.json.encodeToString() to throw SerializationException on startup when seeding initial project; plus R8 stripped serializers due to missing -keep rule for app.data package.
known_issues.resolution: Annotated ProjectSummary with @Serializable, updated proguard-rules.pro with full keep rules for app and kotlinx.serialization, hardened loadProjects with defensive try/catch, and added unit test ProjectRepositoryTest.

queue.title: Fix the crash on creating text and shape layers (highest priority)
queue.notes: Root cause identified: CanvasView and EffectSettingsSheet called Color(ULong) inline constructor passing ARGB value directly into internal Color.value, corrupting ColorSpace ID and triggering IllegalArgumentException on draw. Replaced with safeColor(argb.toInt()). Added QuarantinedLayerData and LayerType.QUARANTINED with recoverProjectDocument in SgProjectArchive to quarantine corrupt layers without crashing. Added structured local crash log in MainActivity and attached to DeviceInfoProvider. Verified with LayerRegressionTest passing all layer types and quarantine.

queue.title: Safe-area insets (status bar and navigation bar)
queue.notes: Added statusBarsPadding and displayCutoutPadding to TopPanel, navigationBarsPadding to BottomPanel, NewProjectScreen, ExportScreen, and HomeScreen FAB. Configured WindowCompat insets controller in Theme.kt for status and navigation bar icon contrast in both dark and light modes.

queue.title: Remove the default sample project
queue.notes: Removed seeding of sample project on first launch (empty list returned, triggering friendly empty state). Added upgrade migration in ProjectRepository to remove untouched seed project ('My First Salty Design' with 2 layers) and delete its .sg file while preserving all user-created or edited projects. Verified with ProjectRepositoryTest.

queue.title: The control library (both slider types, color picker, and more)
queue.notes: Implemented unified control library in ui.controls: RulerSlider (scroll wheel with tick marks, center indicator needle, haptics, reset label button, and value pill), ProgressSliderControl, ColorPickerRow with ColorPickerDialog (HSV gradient, hue, alpha, hex input, RGB, presets, and transparent support), ToggleControl, DropdownControl, and SegmentedChipsControl. Integrated SliderStyle (RULER/PROGRESS) and units into ControlDefinition in engine. Auto-generator in EffectSettingsSheet connected. Verified with ControlLibraryValidationTest.

queue.title: Tap-to-edit values with a proper input experience
queue.notes: Implemented ValueEditorDialog with imePadding floating above keyboard. Shows label, current value, allowed range, and numeric input. Strict validation refuses non-numeric and out-of-range inputs by turning field red, showing allowed range hint, and disabling OK button. Valid input applies immediately. Verified with unit tests covering position, opacity, and font size controls.

queue.title: The bottom panel becomes a fixed panel, not a row
queue.notes: R6 verified in green Actions 42249077771: all debug/release JVM tests and release APK build pass. Compose tests simulate safe insets across 320x480, 412x860, 1000x800 and 640x360; all add/selected tools visible, preview separated, Delete one action and undo restores layer. No UI refinement.

queue.title: Project settings versus app settings
queue.notes: R7 verified in green Actions 42250089407: real editor gear Compose test opens Project settings without app navigation, background and grid/snap preferences archive round-trip, background undo, native bitmap PNG/WebP real-alpha tests, and release APK build all pass.

queue.title: Theme (dark, light, system)
queue.notes: Verified in green Actions 42255375629: Dark default, Light/Dark/System persistence, live semantic theme updates and both system-bar icon contrasts. All debug/release JVM tests and release APK compilation passed. Theme test drives system-state changes through a StateFlow to match observer delivery; direct external snapshot mutation stalled the Robolectric harness.

queue.title: Visual aspect ratio picker (New Project)
queue.notes: Implemented visual aspect ratio picker with true proportional mini shape tiles, horizontal row of most-used ratios, expandable grid with standard/social/paper categories, orientation rotate toggle (portrait <-> landscape), live-updating custom dimension tile with R5 tap-to-edit ValueEditorDialog. Verified with AspectRatioPickerTest (calculations, rotation, range validation, and canvas creation).

queue.title: Text options (reference: Keyflaw's Text options)
queue.notes: Implemented Text Options in-panel page inside fixed bottom panel with live text preview, Font selector row leading to Font sub-page, RulerSlider for size, color picker swatch, Left/Center/Right/Justify alignment chips, Free/Paragraph/Fixed/Shrink-fit box mode chips, line spacing (%), letter spacing (‰ em) with reset button, outline stroke toggle/swatch/width slider, and shape/vector path selector with offset slider. Updated CanvasView with native text rendering, outline drawing, and path-following. Verified in FontManagerTest and TextOptionsUITest.

queue.title: Vector creation and editing (reference: Keyflaw's vector tool)
queue.notes: Verified in green Actions 42270618002: debug/release JVM tests and APK compilation. Touch tests add points, drag, switch corner/smooth, open/close paths, add/select a second path, remove, undo and archive-reload. Native tests verify fill/stroke, multi-contour SVG, reject entities/external resources; engine tests verify shape-preserving cubic splits, fractional corner moves, inverse transforms and multi-path roundtrip. Vector creation, six in-pane tabs, numeric point/handle values and native export renderer implemented. Basic SVG curves/arcs import as bounded editable sampled polylines.

queue.title: Built-in fonts and importing several fonts at once
queue.notes: Bundled 7 open-license fonts (Inter, Montserrat, Playfair Display, Oswald, Dancing Script, JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Serif) in assets/fonts and added docs/licenses/FONTS_OFL.txt. Built FontManager supporting multi-file TTF/OTF import with magic byte header validation, size checks, Typeface test parsing, duplicate prevention, deletion, and typeface caching. Created FontSelectionPage with search, style chips, and built-in/imported tags. Verified in FontManagerTest and TextOptionsUITest.

decisions: Publish releases only on new v* tags; main pushes build and upload artifacts without replacing existing versioned release assets.

R6: usable portrait workspace gets 40% height clamped 260–340dp and capped at 45%; landscape (width > height) or width >=840dp docks tools right, 40% width clamped 280–360dp and capped at 45%. Insets excluded before sizing. No drag handle or resize.

queue.title: Complete the project export and import (.sg)
queue.notes: Root cause: .sg project container lacked history action tree serialization, format version gating, embedded media/font asset handling, and export entry points in ExportScreen and Editor. Implemented SgManifest with semantic formatVersion gating (rejects major version > 1 with clear message), ActionTreeSnapshot history serialization, self-contained project assets folder synchronization, duplicate import auto-renaming, and added Save Project (.sg) to ExportScreen, HomeScreen (single & multi-selection), and Editor TopPanel menu. Verified with comprehensive SgRoundTripTest.

queue.title: Project thumbnails on Home
queue.notes: Root cause: Home project cards rendered a static vector icon placeholder with hardcoded text plural ("1 layers"). Implemented ProjectThumbnailRenderer proxy renderer (~512px) off the main thread with transparency checkerboard, layer stack rendering, LRU memory cache, disk cache in thumbnails/, auto-generation on create/edit/import/migration, and duplicate/delete lifecycle handling. Fixed layer plural text to ("No layers", "1 layer", "N layers"). Verified with ProjectRepositoryTest.
